# label: install-distribution components (dxc;dxcompiler;dxc-headers)
# build: <build>  (config Release)
# prefix: <prefix>  (scratch, outside the repository)
# components: dxc,dxcompiler,dxc-headers

$ "cmake" --install <build> --config Release --prefix <prefix> --component dxc
-- Installing: <prefix>/bin/dxc.exe
# exit: 0
$ "cmake" --install <build> --config Release --prefix <prefix> --component dxcompiler
-- Installing: <prefix>/bin/dxcompiler.dll
# exit: 0
$ "cmake" --install <build> --config Release --prefix <prefix> --component dxc-headers
-- Installing: <prefix>/include/dxc/config.h
-- Installing: <prefix>/include/dxc/dxcapi.h
-- Installing: <prefix>/include/dxc/dxcerrors.h
-- Installing: <prefix>/include/dxc/dxcisense.h
# exit: 0

# installed files: 6
       4  <prefix>/include/dxc
       2  <prefix>/bin/

# every file, sorted (destinations relative to the install prefix):
<prefix>/bin/dxc.exe
<prefix>/bin/dxcompiler.dll
<prefix>/include/dxc/config.h
<prefix>/include/dxc/dxcapi.h
<prefix>/include/dxc/dxcerrors.h
<prefix>/include/dxc/dxcisense.h
